prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t look up live, current ratings, so I can’t name a single “best” dentist in Pleasanton right now. “Best” depends on what matters most to you (insurance, price, evening hours, gentle chairside manner, experience with anxious patients, etc.). I can, however, help you find the best fit quickly. Here’s a short plan and what to look for:

How to find the best dentist for a checkup & cleaning
- Use local directories with filters and recent reviews:
  - Google Maps (search “dentist Pleasanton CA” and sort by rating/reviews)
  - Yelp, Zocdoc, Healthgrades
  - ADA “Find a Dentist” tool
- Filter by your needs: accepts your insurance/finances, convenient hours, proximity, languages spoken, experience treating anxious patients or adults/children.
- Check credentials: DDS/DMD, state license, years in practice, membership in professional organizations.
- Read recent patient reviews for cleanliness, punctuality, friendly staff, and quality of routine cleanings.

Questions to ask before booking
- Do you accept my insurance (or offer a self-pay/new patient special)?
- What is included in a new patient checkup and cleaning? (prophylaxis, bitewing X‑rays, oral cancer screening)
- How long is the appointment and who does the cleaning (hygienist vs dentist)?
- Are there any COVID/flu precautions or wait-room procedures I should know?
- What are your cancellation/no-show policies?

What to expect at a checkup & cleaning
- New patient paperwork, medical history review
- Full mouth exam and gum charting; bitewing X‑rays if needed
- Professional cleaning (scaling and polishing) by a hygienist
- Discussion of findings and recommended next steps (fillings, deep cleaning, etc.)

Typical cost ranges (estimate — verify with the office)
- Routine cleaning (adult, without periodontal disease): roughly $75–$200
- New patient exam + X‑rays: roughly $50–$250
(Exact costs depend on office, X‑rays and insurance.)

If you want, I can:
- Give a short script/message you can use to call or email offices.
- Help narrow options if you tell me your ZIP code, insurance, and any preferences (evening hours, pediatric care, sedation/anxiety help).
Which would be most helpful?
